CONFIDENTIALITY AGREEMENT

This Agreement is dated 08/08/2025

BETWEEN
(1) Apex Locksmiths Limited, a company incorporated in England and Wales with company number 05765223) whose registered office is Brunswick House, 163 Mill Mews, Swindon SN4 1JY ("Party A"); and
(2) Bluebell Ironbridge & Co Ltd (company no. 12148178) of Navigation Point, Allen Road, London SE20 8HP ("Party B").

BACKGROUND
(A) The parties wish to exchange information for the purpose of reviewing a pilot of the Discloser's analytics platform.
(B) Each party has agreed to keep that information confidential on the terms of this Agreement.

Contact for notices: Jaspreet Iyer, j.iyer@apexlocksmithslimited.co.uk, 029 7978 4178

## 1. Definitions
1.1 "Confidential Infor-
mation" means all information of a confidential nature disclosed by either party to the other party, whether in writing, orally or by any other means, including business plans, customer lists, pricing, software, designs and know-how.

1.2 References to a party include its Representatives.

## 2. Obligations
2.1 Each party shall not copy or reproduce the Confidential Information except as reasonably required for the Purpose.

2.2 The Recipient will use the Confidential Information only for the Purpose and will protect it with at least the same degree of care it uses for its own information.

## 3. Exceptions
3.1 This Agreement does not restrict the use of information which is already public, or which must be disclosed by law or by order of a court or regulator, provided notice is given where lawful.

## 4. Return of information
4.1 On request, the other party shall return or destroy all documents containing Confidential Information and confirm in writing that it has done so.

1 | Initials: JI

Apex Locksmiths Limited / NDA

## 5. Term
5.1 The confidentiality obligations survive termination for a period of 5 years.

## 6. General
6.1 All Confidential Information remains the property of the Discloser.

6.2 The parties will negotiate in good faith in relation to any dispute arising under this Agreement.

6.3 This Agreement is governed by Scots law.

6.4 This Agreement may only be varied in writing signed by both parties.

Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and marked for the attention of Miss Iyer (or J. Iyer, if Jaspreet has left the business).

SIGNED by the parties on the date stated above.

Signed by Jaspreet Iyer, Director, for and on behalf of Party A ______________________
Date: 8th August 2025

Signed by Irene Charlton, Authorised signatory, for and on behalf of Party B ..............................
Date: 08/08/2025
